title: Verify: ui manifest entries validate and match SVG dimensions unit tests
summary: Unit tests check the ui manifest entries parse, resolve and match the SVG sizes.
description: Read-only unit tests over manifest.json and the ui SVGs; no app is started.
acceptance_criteria: Given manifest.json, When parsed with parseManifest, Then ok is true
Given each ui entry, When its path is resolved under game/public/assets, Then the file exists and its SVG size equals the manifest dimensions

steps.action: Create a test that reads ../public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json, asserts parseManifest(raw).ok is true, then for ids ui:icon-sound, ui:panel-frame and ui:cursor-pointer asserts the entry exists, existsSync(join(publicRoot, entry.path)) is true, and the SVG width and height attributes parsed with regex equal entry.dimensions (16x16, 24x24, 16x16).
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/publicAssetUiManifest.test.ts
